sweep.measure: ratio of mean MASE to seasonal naive with full history

sweep_grid.measure: geometric mean over windows of MASE relative to seasonal naive (same half-hour last week) with 7 days
sweep_grid.note: baseline = seasonal naive (same half-hour last week) with 7 days; null = cannot fit

sweep_retail_floor.measure: ratio of mean MASE to seasonal naive with full history
sweep_retail_floor.note: same products, targets and baseline as sweep; null = cannot fit
